title.zh: 赌场管制（当局复核）条例 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Casino Control (Review by Authority) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 21 September 2026.

heading.en: Failure to comply with time limits, etc.

text.en:
3.—(1) The Authority may refuse any request for review —
(a)that is not made in accordance with section 184(2) or (3) of the Act; or
(b)if the applicant fails to provide any information required by the Authority in the manner or within the period specified by the Authority under section 184(4) of the Act.
(2) A request for review must be accompanied by any documents or information supporting the grounds on which the request is made.
(3) The Authority may disregard any other information that was submitted to the Authority after the time delimited by section 184(2) of the Act or after the expiry of the time limit for the giving of the information specified by the Authority under section 184(4) of the Act, as the case may be.

heading.en: Decision on review to be notified

text.en: 4. When the Authority has made a decision under section 184(5) of the Act regarding a request for review made to it, the Authority must without delay notify the applicant of the Authority’s decision in respect of the request for review.

heading.en: Withdrawal of request for review at any time

text.en: 5. An applicant may withdraw the applicant’s request for review at any time before the Authority makes a decision under section 184(5) of the Act in respect of the request for review; and the applicant is then treated as not having made any request for review.
